Propose a transfer of ZEC. Shows the fee, then 'confirm' transmits it.

Example:
    send ztestsapling1x65nq4dgp0qfywgxcwk9n0fvm4fysmapgr2q00p85ju252h6l7mmxu2jg9cqqhtvzd69jwhgv8d 200000 "Hello from the command line"
    confirm


Usage: send <address> <zatoshis> "<optional memo>"
       send '[{"address":"<address>", "amount":<zatoshis>, "memo":"<optional memo>"}, ...]'

Arguments:
  [ARGS]...
          

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
